# Subway Seat for Alacritty

Normal, bright and dim colours, both cursors, selection, search, hints, footer bar and line indicator. `general.import` needs Alacritty 0.14 or later; older versions use a top-level `import`.

[Alacritty](https://alacritty.org) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/alacritty/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.toml`](subway-seat.toml) | ~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat.toml |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.toml`](subway-seat-tunnel.toml) | ~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.toml`](subway-seat-enamel.toml) | ~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat-enamel.toml |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml:

```toml
[general]
import = ["~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat.toml"]
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml:

```toml
[general]
import = ["~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml"]
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml:

```toml
[general]
import = ["~/.config/alacritty/themes/subway-seat-enamel.toml"]
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
